change: chore/enterprise-ci-gates: adopt enterprise skills as enforced per-skill CI gates

architectural-decision-records.why: This change ships architecturally significant decisions (ADR-0002, ADR-0003) and wires an ADR gate.
architectural-decision-records.what: Wrote ADR-0002 and ADR-0003; wired check:adr as the architectural-decision-records CI check.
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

judge-arch.why: Configured the mechanical architecture gate and wired it as judge-arch's own CI check.
judge-arch.what: Authored arch-gate.config.json and decisions.md; wired check:architecture + check:links as the judge-arch check.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

arch-encode.why: Encoded the Supabase/Sanity data-ownership rule as a mechanical arch-gate rule and wired its discrimination gate.
arch-encode.what: Added the 'Sanity owns prose, not facts' forbid rule; wired check:discriminate as the arch-encode check.
quotes: A rule you can check mechanically is the goal

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: The standing system shape (layers, ownership) is recorded and enforced by the architecture gate.
enterprise-architecture-standards.what: Recorded the intended shape in decisions.md and AGENTS.md; wired check:architecture as this skill's check.
quotes: Most systems do not fail because nobody knew the right pattern

verifiable-quality-gates.why: Mirrored the component discrimination suite so every vendored gate script is proven to detect.
verifiable-quality-gates.what: Added the 29-file test suite and npm test; wired it as the verifiable-quality-gates CI check; proved it green (434 pass).
quotes: A quality gate is only worth the failures it catches

skeptical-audit.why: Every factual claim in the ADRs and this receipt carries an evidence state and a named limitation.
skeptical-audit.what: Recorded honest limits in ADR-0002/0003; wired check:evidence (skill-evidence-contract) as this skill's check.
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

pattern-selector.why: Wired the pattern-catalog completeness gate as pattern-selector's own CI check.
pattern-selector.what: Wired check:patterns over the design and enterprise pattern catalogs (61 entries validated).
quotes: Two mistakes cost you, and they pull in opposite directions

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: Seeded and validated the data map that the pii and retention gates enforce.
compliance-data-lifecycle.what: Authored data-map.json with lawful basis and retention; wired check:retention + check:pii as this skill's check.
quotes: Two things quietly block software from being enterprise-ready. It cannot prove it handles data lawfully

release-deployment-safety.why: Wired the expand/contract migration-safety gate and proved it bites on a destructive migration.
release-deployment-safety.what: Wired check:migrations (guarded) as this skill's check; verified it fails on DROP TABLE and passes a safe ADD COLUMN.
quotes: Most production outages are not caused by bad code. They are caused by how good code was shipped

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: Declared the product audiences and wired the BDD structural gate as this skill's check.
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: Authored features/bdd-config.json (audiences) and wired check:gherkin + check:bdd-tags (guarded).
quotes: A feature isn't done when the happy path works for the person who built it

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: Wired the test-shape (pyramid) gate as this skill's check, activating when a JUnit report exists.
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: Wired check:test-shape (guarded) as the comprehensive-test-strategy CI check.
quotes: BDD scenarios prove a feature behaves correctly, but that is only part of what strong teams test

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: Wired the OWASP mechanical lints as this skill's check, activating when application source lands.
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: Wired check:owasp:lints (guarded) as the owasp-secure-coding-bdd CI check.
quotes: Most breaches come from a short list of mistakes that are well understood and well documented

universal-browser-device-support.why: Wired the no-user-agent-sniffing gate as this skill's check, activating when source lands.
universal-browser-device-support.what: Wired check:no-ua (guarded) as the universal-browser-device-support CI check.
quotes: on a fast laptop can be broken in Safari, unusable on a 360px phone

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: Wired the a11y checklist/axe gate as this skill's check, activating when a UI surface lands.
universal-accessibility-wcag.what: Wired check:a11y:checklist (guarded) as the universal-accessibility-wcag CI check.
quotes: Roughly one in six people lives with a disability

sre-operational-readiness.why: Wired the alert-hygiene gate as this skill's check, activating when alert rules land.
sre-operational-readiness.what: Wired check:alerts (guarded) as the sre-operational-readiness CI check.
quotes: systems treat reliability as a measured, budgeted engineering property, not a hope

usability-ux-universal-design.why: The library ships no standalone lint, so this skill is enforced by receipt coupling to every UI change; its CI check asserts that coupling is wired.
usability-ux-universal-design.what: Coupled usability-ux to UI changes in skill-receipt.config.json and wired the assertion as its CI check.
quotes: makes a product possible to use for people with

change: docs/readme-giuliana-line: add a greeting line to README.md

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: Appends one line of prose to README.md; no service, schema, module boundary, or integration is designed or changed.

pattern-selector.why: No feature, class, module, or data flow is added or refactored, so there is no design force to select a pattern for.

architectural-decision-records.why: A documentation greeting line is not an architecturally significant decision; nothing is added, moved, deleted, or restructured in code or schema.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: The change touches no input, auth, session, access control, crypto, file handling, API, or dependency; it is static README text.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: No behavior or use case changes; README prose has no audiences or Gherkin scenarios to enumerate.

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: No executable code is added or changed, so there is no unit/integration/e2e/contract/load/chaos surface to test.

release-deployment-safety.why: Nothing that runs in production changes; no migration, feature flag, or rollout is involved in a README edit.

sre-operational-readiness.why: No service, endpoint, SLI/SLO, alert, or runbook is affected by adding a line to the README.

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: No personal or regulated data, schema, retention, backup, or audit-logging surface is touched; the line is non-personal static text.

judge-arch.why: No code or schema file changes; the fresh-context review recorded in docs/arch-reviews/log.jsonl found an empty four-questions matrix for this docs-only change.

arch-encode.why: No architectural mistake or drift pattern was caught that needs encoding into a mechanical arch-gate rule.

verifiable-quality-gates.why: No automated check or guard is added or changed, so there is no detector to prove non-vacuous.

skeptical-audit.why: This receipt and the review carry evidence states and limitations, but the change itself asserts no factual claim about the system to audit.

universal-browser-device-support.why: No frontend, HTML, CSS, JS, or component renders in a browser from a README text line.

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: No UI component, form, image, color, or interaction is added; README markdown renders no app surface subject to WCAG.

usability-ux-universal-design.why: No user-facing feature, flow, screen, or microcopy in the product is changed by a line appended to the repository README.
